title: Big Lots Recalls Ottomans Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The center of the ottoman can collapse during normal use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: Hitachi Koki Recalls Pneumatic Nailers Due to Injury Hazards
summary: The pneumatic nailers can jam and override the safety switch that permits only one nail to fire at a time, posing an injury risk. Units: About 25,000 units in the United States and 300 in Canada.

title: Bubble Knobs Recalled by Cost Plus Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Cost Plus World Market and World Market Stores
summary: The knobs can break and expose sharp pieces of glass, posing a risk of laceration to the consumer. Units: About 251,400.

title: SCOTT Recalls Speedster Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The steerer tube in the front fork can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,000 in the United States.

title: Weil-McLain Recalls Ultra Series Boilers Due to Risk of Fire, Explosion
summary: A cap on the boiler's manifold can crack and release gas into the home, posing a risk of fire and explosion. Units: About 7,900 in the United States and 540 in Canada.

title: Lea Industries Recalls Bunk Beds with Bookcases Due to Risk of Entrapment (Recall Alert)
summary: The bunk bed can be assembled incorrectly, creating a space that exceeds the 1.88 inches allowed by the industry standard, posing an entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 500.

title: Mirka Recalls Compact Electric Random Orbital Sanders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The sander can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 440 U.S. and 85 in Canada.

title: phil&teds Recalls Infant Car Seat Adaptors for Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic adaptors used to connect an infant car seat to a stroller can crack, become unstable and break during use, posing a fall hazard to infants. Units: About 265 in the U.S. and 122 in Canada.

title: Mission Archery Recalls Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard; Can Fire Unexpectedly
summary: The crossbow can fire an arrow unexpectedly without the trigger being pulled, posing an injury hazard to the user and to bystanders. Units: About 9,500.

title: Winco Recalls Contraband 24 Canister Shell Fireworks Kit Due to Impact, Burn Hazards
summary: The shell can blow up in the tube during firing, posing impact and burn hazards to the user and bystanders. Units: About 4,500 kits.

title: Roland Recalls Digital Pianos Due to Electrical Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The AC power cord can be connected to the XLR output jacks, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 640.

title: Wolf Steel Recalls Napoleon Propane Gas Fireplaces Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The pressure from the ignition of the propane gas can cause the glass front to break, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 600 units in the United States and 2,400 in Canada.

title: Coravin Recalls to Repair Wine Access System Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The system can cause wine bottles to break during pressurization, posing a risk of lacerations. Units: About 65,000 in the U.S. and about 640 in Canada.

title: Scott, Trek Recall Bicycles with SR Suntour Front Forks Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The front fork can break, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 5,200 forks on Scott bicycles and about 120,000 forks on Trek bicycles.

title: Women's Scarves Recalled by Julie Vos Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The scarves fail to meet the federal flammability standard for wearing apparel and pose a risk of burn injury to consumers. Units: About 324.

title: Stile Products Recalls Tern Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Frames Can Crack
summary: The bike's frame can crack at the hinge on the top tube, posing a fall hazard. Units: 650 in the U.S. and about 20 in Canada.

title: Trane Recalls Air Conditioning Systems Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ground screws used in some units do not have the two threads required to provide sufficient grounding, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 100,600.

title: Linear Expands Recall of Personal Emergency Reporting System Transmitters Due to Battery Signal Failure
summary: The batteries used in the transmitters can fail to emit a low battery warning leading the user to believe the transmitter is functioning and not generate a warning. Units: About 175,000 (an additional 48,000 previously recalled in December 2013).

title: Reebok-CCM Recalls Throat Collars Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Throat collars have been decertified by BNQ in Canada due to the risk that a skate blade could penetrate the collar, posing a laceration hazard to the throat. Units: About 3,300 in the United States and 8,100 in Canada.

title: Brooks Furniture Recalls Glider Rockers Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively to Kaplan Early Learning
summary: The spindles in the glider base can separate while rocking, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 350.

title: Nokia Recalls Tablet Travel Chargers Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The plastic cover on the charger's exchangeable plugs can come loose and separate, exposing internal components that pose an electrocution hazard if touched while the plug remains in a live socket. Units: About 500.

title: American Signature Recalls Table Lamps Due to Risk of Shock, Fire (Recall Alert)
summary: Improper wiring can pose shock and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 730.
